title: Detailed glasses
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <g>
    <!-- left lens frame -->
    <ellipse cx='30' cy='50' rx='20' ry='17' fill='none' stroke='#42f5e0' stroke-width='4'/>
    <!-- right lens frame -->
    <ellipse cx='70' cy='50' rx='20' ry='17' fill='none' stroke='#42f5e0' stroke-width='4'/>
    <!-- bridge -->
    <path d='M50 47 Q50 42 50 47' fill='none' stroke='#42f5e0' stroke-width='4'/>
    <line x1='50' y1='50' x2='50' y2='50' stroke='#42f5e0' stroke-width='4'/>
    <path d='M50 50 Q42 44 50 50' fill='none' stroke='#42f5e0' stroke-width='4'/>
    <!-- lens glass left -->
    <ellipse cx='30' cy='50' rx='19' ry='16' fill='#1a6b7a' opacity='0.45'/>
    <!-- lens glass right -->
    <ellipse cx='70' cy='50' rx='19' ry='16' fill='#1a6b7a' opacity='0.45'/>
    <!-- left hinge / arm -->
    <rect x='8' y='47' width='6' height='6' rx='2' fill='#f5c542'/>
    <path d='M8 50 L2 46 L2 54 Z' fill='#f5c542'/>
    <!-- right hinge / arm -->
    <rect x='86' y='47' width='6' height='6' rx='2' fill='#f5c542'/>
    <path d='M92 50 L98 46 L98 54 Z' fill='#f5c542'/>
    <!-- left temple arm folding back -->
    <path d='M14 50 Q6 40 8 30' fill='none' stroke='#f5c542' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <!-- right temple arm folding back -->
    <path d='M86 50 Q94 40 92 30' fill='none' stroke='#f5c542' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <!-- highlights on lenses -->
    <path d='M20 42 Q25 38 32 40' fill='none' stroke='#b0fff5' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.8'/>
    <path d='M60 42 Q65 38 72 40' fill='none' stroke='#b0fff5' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.8'/>
    <!-- tiny sparkle -->
    <circle cx='34' cy='56' r='2' fill='#b0fff5'/>
    <circle cx='66' cy='56' r='2' fill='#b0fff5'/>
  </g>
</svg>
